field.label: Listen address
field.help: LISTEN: comma-separated host:port list, e.g. 127.0.0.1:8080 or [::1]:8080. Avoid exposing the dashboard on WAN.

field.label: Interfaces
field.help: INTERFACES: comma-separated device names to show (e.g. igb0,igb1,wg0). Empty shows all.

field.label: WAN device
field.help: WAN_INTERFACE: device name of the WAN (e.g. igb0 or pppoe0). Empty auto-detects via the default route.

field.label: Local networks
field.help: LOCAL_NETS: comma-separated CIDRs used to classify top talkers as local.
